title: GDN forward, five stages plus saved state
formula: o[c] = (q[c] @ S) * exp(g_cum[c]) + attn[c] @ v_new[c] with S <- S*exp(g_last) + (k[c]*exp(g_last - g_cum[c]))^T @ v_new[c], chunked at L=64, D=128, BF16 tensors and state with FP32 gates, zero initial state
study_for: A five-launch pipeline whose forward also publishes the backward's saved state. main.py's `execute` is the whole composition: preprocess -> strict triangular inverse -> recompute WU -> scores -> recurrence, with every destination allocated NaN-poisoned by the caller and handed to OpExec with `seed_outputs=True`. The seams are fp32 (`g_cumsum`, `decay_mask`, `strict_lower`) up to the bf16 WU handoff, and bf16 after it.

The recurrent tail exists as two kernels, `gdn_recurrent_plain` and `gdn_recurrent_saved`, running the same recurrence with and without the four history stores. Their entry names differ so their generated artifacts cannot collide, and `--stages` launches both: a disagreement between them is the saved kernel's extra stores disturbing its own state, which a single-kernel check could not tell from an error in the shared maths.

`make_kexp_vf` and `make_kexp_saved_vf` are the same weighted-key arithmetic, but the saved one additionally writes the fp32 `exp_delta` row and an ND copy of the bf16 weighted key beside the NZ one. They started life under one name in two stage modules, which is exactly the kind of near-duplicate that separate files hide and one file makes visible.

`tril_inverse64_v2_strict_bf16_kernel` keeps two slots per L1/L0C ring and reuses its first-use inputs (`a10/a21/a31/a32`) as temporary and product storage once their MTE1 reads have retired. It needs 32 Cube and 30 Vec mutex IDs including the default L0A/L0B scratch, and holds explicit M-to-FIX and FIX-to-MTE1 events around the publish because of the PyPTO Acc-to-Mat pipe selection gap (A5-UP-039).
do_not_copy_when: You need a trainable or otherwise nonzero initial state. Only the zero-initial-state path is implemented, and the backward this forward feeds has no `d_initial_state` to match.
Your chunk length is not 64 or your head dimension is not 128. There is no L or D tail path here at all: the producers partition whole 64x128 tiles and the recurrent kernels partition whole BH pairs.

You are copying the preprocess precision into a backward. This forward computes bf16 `key @ key.T` with fp32 accumulation and applies beta afterwards in fp32; delta_rule_bwd and gdn_bwd round `key*beta` into the bf16 cube operand before the matmul. The two conventions disagree at the third digit and must not be swapped silently.
You want the ungated delta rule. Set `g == 0` and every `exp(g_cumsum)` factor collapses to 1 and the decay mask becomes a constant causal keep; delta_rule_fwd is that case written without the gate.
